sections.heading: Recognised twice among *Africa’s fastest-growing companies*
sections.body:
Linkfields has been recognised twice in the Financial Times and Statista ranking of Africa’s Fastest-Growing Companies: at **#35 in the 2026 edition** and at #38 in 2023. The ranking is compiled independently from verified revenue growth; the 2026 edition recognises the companies with the strongest growth between 2021 and 2024.

The original publishers and dates are shown below. For practical guidance on current enterprise challenges, visit [Enterprise insights](/company/blog). For our company positioning and delivery footprint, see [About Linkfields](/company/about-us).
